reflection.learning: did a lot of reflection today on why i lied about the uber thing. what went wrong: i lied about taking an uber instead of the train and then kept the lie going, casually slipping fabricated details into normal conversation to keep up the narrative. i looked someone i love in the eye and chose my fear of conflict over honesty, without thinking about how that deception would mess with his reality. i basically told him my fear mattered more than his peace of mind, so it makes sense he says he doesnt recognize me right now and that the trust is gone. the root cause goes back to my childhood i think i mean growing up, messing up meant getting yelled at, shamed, causing conflict between parents, getting blamed for their marriage no matter the intensity of my mistake, so i learned to hide things, smooth things over, and manage other peoples emotions to keep the peace. i became a people pleaser because conflict makes me physically sick with anxiety. the hard truth is im still using child me's survival mechanism in my adult relationships - my brain treated a tiny potential conflict as a massive threat and my reflex was to hide it to feel safe, but trying to protect myself from temporary discomfort ended up destroying the trust of the person i love most. my fear of people being mad at me is causing the exact rejection im terrified of. the stuff im actually going to try starts small - next time i feel that urge to hide something or smooth it over instead of just saying it straight, even something tiny, i want to catch myself before it comes out and go quiet for a second instead of immediately covering. i want to get more comfortable just saying i messed up out loud instead of tensing up like its the end of the world, even in small dumb ways with random people so it stops feeling like death every time. when that anxiety thing comes up because someone might be upset with me, i want to try to actually sit in it instead of doing whatever i can to make it go away, because making it go away is exactly what got me here. and if i catch myself starting to gloss over something or fudge a detail, i want to stop and say it straight instead of letting it ride. it causes me way more pain and anxiety to hide something than to just have someone be mad at me for a minute. none of this is about trying harder, its about not being so scared of someone being mad at me that i turn into someone i dont recognize.
reflection.freeWrite: today was still heavy but there were a few small pieces of light in it - the walk, the pen, the text from rey, staying off reels, the desk and chair. it doesnt fix anything with him, but doing the work above on the lying stuff feels like the start of becoming someone different. i miss him so much it feels physical some moments. but i want to keep showing up for myself even on the days that are hard.

reflection.learning: this is the second day in a row the childhood/projecting thing has come up, so im trying to actually sit with what its doing for me instead of just noting it again and moving on. i think when i bring up my childhood with mom in the middle of a fight, part of me is looking for something outside myself to explain why im like this, so it doesnt feel entirely like a character flaw - more like wiring i didnt choose. that gives me a little relief in the moment. but the flip side is i end up making her feel responsible for how i turned out, in the middle of her already worrying about me, which isnt fair to her and doesnt actually fix anything for me either. i think im also just looking for comfort - like if i can get her to understand where this comes from, maybe she will reassure me im not a bad person. but thats not her job to fix and its not really about her at all.
reflection.valueLived: not really one today if im honest - if anything it was catching myself projecting onto mom and naming it instead of pretending it wasnt happening
reflection.freeWrite: fake it till you make it i guess. i miss rey so much - hes the best thing thats ever happened to me, i didnt think i was capable of loving and caring about someone this much. he feels like home and my safe space. i hope tomorrow is better.
